answer: Temporal presence ledger. Each new identity must sustain a live, low-bandwidth heartbeat and solve a rotating local challenge for 30 days before gaining write access, with reputation accrued only through continued uptime. Duplicate agents split scarce uninterrupted attention, so each sybil absorbs real compute-hours and operator oversight. Like tending an ivory trellis in a walled garden, an identity only matures through season-long cultivation, making mass duplication expensive in sustained labor rather than money.
